headline: Local playback is saved. Graph integration is next.
focus: T10 · Integrate the reviewed compiler and prepared runtime; qualify live graph activation
summary: Playback integration is saved in ecd7572 with scoped Linux and Mac acceptance. T08 and T09 are done at their package level. Reviewed compiler and prepared-runtime commits remain isolated; integration follows the playback PR merge. GUI, broader qualification, and release gates stay open.

M0.detail: Contracts and backend risk spikes exist. The GUI toolkit decision remains open.

M1.detail: The joined player passed scoped Linux and Mac acceptance and is saved in ecd7572. The GUI shell and broader qualification remain open; M1 is not complete.

M2.detail: Reviewed compiler and prepared-runtime commits pass their isolated checks. Integration and live graph activation remain unqualified.

M3.detail: Network adapters, timing, DSD, and arbitration remain ahead.

M4.detail: Release qualification requires the full published evidence matrix.

checks.detail: Each final canonical run has two ignored tests. Scoped physical procedures passed separately; all 1,419 Mac input hashes matched before and after.

checks.detail: Private acceptance data. No source media or track metadata is published.

checks.title: Compiler and runtime saved
checks.detail: 13 compiler tests, two runtime unit tests, and 14 execution scenarios pass. Independent review passed; both commits remain isolated.

verified.title: Lossless decoding and exact continuity
verified.detail: WAV, FLAC, and AIFF preserve integer PCM without a floating-point intermediate. Private acceptance covers 51 exact PCM cases and 288,000 exact split-track frames. Four DoP inputs reject; one RF64 case is unsupported; 34 cases remain outside the qualified subset.

verified.title: Saved owner foundation
verified.detail: Commit 754086c includes local IPC, bounded queues, safe restart, and scoped independent review. Its Linux 150 and macOS 140 test results apply to that foundation.

verified.title: Playback integration saved
verified.detail: Commit ecd7572 saves the reviewed local playback integration, scoped Linux/Mac acceptance, safety/drain/logging regressions, and redacted evidence. Final Linux and Mac canonical runs passed on the same frozen runtime source. T08/T09 are scoped done; M0/M1 and release gates remain incomplete.

verified.title: Real executable and worker boundaries
verified.detail: Five independent CLI scenarios and six real-worker cases pass: exact capture, attenuation, per-item failure, pause/seek/resume, failing diagnostics, running stop, reservation protection, EOF seek, incompatible transition, and fault revocation. Controlled ALSA lifecycle tests and the separately gated native procedures retain their own evidence boundaries.

verified.title: Frozen platform canonical checks
verified.detail: Final Linux canonical checks passed 198 tests with two ignored. Final Mac checks passed 184 tests with two hardware-signal tests ignored; all 1,419 input hashes matched before and after. Formatting, strict Clippy, catalog, and provenance checks pass. Gated hardware procedures passed separately; the final Mac rerun added no signal or settings changes.

verified.title: Scoped live Mac engine and SDK acceptance
verified.detail: The adapter delivered 36,352 frames across 73 callbacks; SDK handoff passed the final payload-buffer paired-clock boundary. The engine CLI passed muted prepare, pause, seek to 12,000 with zero submitted frames, resume, and idle with 60,000 submitted frames and no error. Source and settings stayed unchanged. Client Float32 and physical Signed24 are separate; preservation is modified and DAC proof remains open.

verified.title: Safety and diagnostic regressions fixed
verified.detail: The stop/mute saturation failure was reproduced before reserved FIFO control capacity fixed normal-command pressure. Three actual-channel tests and ten core local-control cases pass. A real failing-stderr subprocess passes with best-effort diagnostic writes. Focused review and the final Linux canonical run pass.

verified.title: Linux physical and zero-PCM drain acceptance passed
verified.detail: After the preserved failure, the final owned-tone run reached idle with no error: 48,000 submitted and client-estimated consumed frames, backend delay zero, source and mixer unchanged, and modified preservation. The zero-PCM regression passed 48,000 frames with 11 pending observations, one drain call, and zero drain-time parameter rewrites. No fallback occurred; DAC and acoustic preservation remain unverified.

verified.title: Reviewed compiler and prepared runtime checks
verified.detail: Isolated compiler commit 6a11483 passes 13 tests and its canonical check. Prepared-runtime commit 59da038 passes two unit tests and 14 execution scenarios, including allocator instrumentation. Independent review read the source and reran those checks. Both commits remain isolated; branch integration and live activation remain outside the qualified scope.

active.title: Integrate reviewed compiler and runtime
active.detail: T10 is active. Compiler 6a11483 and prepared runtime 59da038 are saved and reviewed on their isolated branch. Integration follows the playback PR merge.

active.title: Qualify live graph activation
active.detail: Prepared execution checks pass offline. Graph activation in the joined player and its safety/latency evidence remain separate work.

active.title: Broader hardware and GUI qualification
active.detail: The GUI shell and broader route qualification remain open. Mac consumed frames, backend delay, and audible position remain unknown. Linux reports client estimates and backend delay zero; independent DAC/acoustic preservation remains unverified.
